visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Flags with Bit Operators
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Permissions are stored as a sum and tested with division and remainder. Use named bit flags with | and &. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Each flag is one bit, so OR combines flags and AND tests them. Adding the same flag twice with + would corrupt the value, while | is safe, and the test no longer needs division.
